newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault boosts Megane Scenic capacity.
newsitem.headline: Renault boosts Megane Scenic capacity.

text.p: French carmaker Renault SA has increased its capacity to produce Megane Scenic cars to 700 a day from 450 but is still not keeping up with sales orders, Chairman Louis Schweitzer said on Thursday.
From the current weekly production of 3,500 models, "we hope to get to 5,000 by the end of the year," he told reporters at a briefing on the company's 1996 results.
"In less than a year, we'll have more than doubled the capacity initially planned," he said. "I'm not sure there are many carmakers that can do that."
The Scenic, a hybrid between a car and minivan, was voted European Car of the Year by motoring journalists last November.
